findings.root_cause: Project pivot from 'Predicting Reaction Yields' to 'Predicting Normalized DFT Total Molecular Energy' due to unavailability of verified real-world datasets containing paired (Reaction SMILES, Experimental Yield, Spectrum) data.
findings.impact_analysis: The primary training and validation pipeline now relies on simulated DFT data (MolSpectra). Consequently, the model is trained and evaluated on simulated data, creating a circular validation loop where the 'ground truth' is generated by the same computational methodology (DFT) used to generate the training targets. Independent experimental validation (FR-010) cannot be performed as no real experimental yield/spectrum pairs matching the DFT targets exist in the current data source.

measures.name: Structure-Only Baseline (T023)
measures.description: Implementation of a baseline model using only molecular fingerprints (ECFP4) without spectral input. This tests if the attention mechanism adds value beyond simple structural encoding, reducing the risk of the model simply memorizing DFT artifacts.

measures.name: Permutation Test (T035)
measures.description: Shuffling target energies to verify that the model cannot achieve significant R² (> 0.05) on random noise. This ensures the model is learning genuine structure-spectrum-energy correlations rather than overfitting to simulation noise.

measures.name: Strict Scaffold Splitting (T017a)
measures.description: Enforcing zero-overlap reaction template splits between train/val/test sets to ensure the model generalizes to unseen chemical scaffolds, a proxy for generalizability to new chemistry.

review_flags.description: The pivot to simulated DFT data fundamentally changes the research question from 'Experimental Yield Prediction' to 'DFT Energy Surrogate Modeling'. This must be explicitly acknowledged in the final research paper and the Spec document must be updated to reflect the new target variable.

The absence of experimental validation (FR-010) means the model's utility for real-world synthesis planning is unproven. Future work must prioritize acquiring or constructing a real-world dataset to satisfy FR-010.

required_outputs: This report must be included in the Research Review Stage deliverables.
The Pivot & Limitation Report (T020c) must aggregate this finding.
